# make-me-unicorn (mmu)

> A deterministic launch gate for AI coding agents. `mmu vibecheck` scans a project for the gaps agent-written code ships most (unverified webhooks, Supabase tables without RLS, secrets in the browser bundle, interpolated SQL) and, installed as a hook, blocks the agent's `git commit` until P0 findings are fixed. Offline, no account, no LLM, about 0.1 s per scan. Python CLI on PyPI as `make-me-unicorn`; MIT.

## Install the gate

- `uvx make-me-unicorn install --claude` writes Claude Code hooks to `.claude/settings.json` (PreToolUse on Bash for git commit/push, Stop, PostToolUse on edits)
- `--codex` (`.codex/hooks.json`), `--cursor` (`.cursor/hooks.json`), `--gemini` (`.gemini/settings.json`), `--git` (pre-commit hook that chains an existing one), `--agents-md` (instruction block in AGENTS.md), `--all`
- `--dry-run` prints the changes; `--uninstall` removes only mmu's entries
- Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add minjikim89/make-me-unicorn` then `/plugin install make-me-unicorn`

## Run a scan

- `mmu vibecheck` whole project; `--staged`, `--changed`, `--since <ref>` limit the scope
- `--format agent` compact fix list for an LLM; `--format json` (schema `mmu.vibecheck/v1`); `--format sarif` (2.1.0)
- Exit codes: 0 nothing blocking, 1 findings at or above `--fail-on` (default P0), 2 the scan could not run
- `--list-rules`, `--explain <rule-id>`
- Suppress a line: `mmu-ignore[<rule-id>]: <reason>` (the reason is required). Suppress a path: `[vibecheck] ignore = ["glob:rule-id"]` in `.mmu/config.toml`
- Existing codebases: `--write-baseline`, then `--baseline` reports only new findings

## Rules

P0 (blocking): secrets, client-bundle-secrets, supabase-rls, webhook-signature, sql-fstring, code-injection, jwt-secret-default, unsafe-deserialization, git-config-exec.
P1 (warning): llm-route-unthrottled, admin-route-no-auth, password-reset, webhook-idempotency, rate-limiting, cors-wildcard, dangerous-html, jwt-localstorage, stack-trace-leak, sourcemaps-exposed, env-not-ignored, disabled-ssl, debug-mode, error-monitoring.

## For agents

- When a hook blocks a commit, the message lists each P0 with file:line, what is wrong, and a fix. Apply the fix and re-run `mmu vibecheck --format agent` until it reports 0 blocking. Suppress only real false positives, with a reason.
- MCP server: `mmu serve-mcp` (extra `[mcp]`) exposes `mmu_vibecheck`, `mmu_explain_rule`, `mmu_list_rules` (read-only), plus launch-checklist blueprint tools.

## Accuracy

docs/benchmark.md: 0 wrong P0 findings across 20 popular open-source apps on review; on 12 fixture projects P0 precision and recall are 100%, 52 of 55 planted issues found. Not covered: authorization logic (IDOR), data flow.

## Also included

Launch checklists for solo builders (15 categories, launch gates M0 to M5, session modes, idea validation): docs/checklists.md.
